title.es: Figura de acción en blíster coleccionable
title.en: Collectible action figure in blister pack

prompt: Create an image of [PERSON] as a collectible action figure inside retro blister packaging. Card header with a bold toy-brand logo, accessories relevant to their job displayed beside the figure, price sticker, slight plastic sheen on the bubble, 90s toy aisle aesthetic.

Design a cinematic movie poster: a lone explorer on a mountain peak above a sea of clouds at golden sunrise, dramatic warm cinematic lighting, ultra-realistic detail, bold title typography at the top reading "[TITLE]", credits block at the bottom.
candid portrait of an elderly fisherman mending nets at dawn, weathered hands in focus, soft overcast light, muted teal and amber palette, documentary photography --ar 4:5 --v 7

title.es: Planificación profunda antes de tocar código

prompt: Ultrathink before writing any code: analyze the architecture of [FEATURE/PROBLEM], list 3 possible approaches with trade-offs, pick one and justify it, then write a step-by-step implementation plan with the files you will touch. Only start implementing after showing me the plan.
sourceName: God of Prompt — Claude Code prompts

title.es: Revisión en dos pasadas del propio código

prompt: After implementing [CHANGE], do a two-pass review of your own diff: pass 1 — correctness only (bugs, edge cases, error handling); pass 2 — quality only (naming, duplication, simplification). Report findings as a list before applying any fix, then apply only the confirmed ones.
A person walks through a neon-lit city street at night, reflections shimmering on wet pavement, slow tracking shot from behind, shallow depth of field, cinematic 4K, moody synthwave color palette.

Subject & action: barista pours latte art in a sunlit café. Camera: slow overhead push-in ending on the cup. Environment & lighting: warm morning light through large windows, dust motes visible. Style & mood: intimate, editorial, film grain. Audio: soft café ambience, milk steaming, no music.

Research [TOPIC]. Give me: (1) a 5-bullet summary of the current state, (2) the 3 most cited sources with one-line credibility notes, (3) one point where reputable sources disagree and why. Prioritize sources from the last 12 months.

Before refactoring [MODULE]: write characterization tests that pin current behavior, run them and confirm green, then refactor in small steps keeping tests green after each one. Never change behavior and structure in the same step. Finish with a diff summary and risk notes.

title.es: Plan de contenidos de una semana

prompt: Act as a content strategist for [BRAND/NICHE]. Build a 7-day content plan: for each day give platform, format (post/reel/carousel), hook line, and a one-sentence outline. Keep the brand voice [TONE] and end with 3 evergreen ideas I can reuse any week.
